title: CustodyJobRequest v1
description: Public custody input. Layers: input = exact option contract to trade; signals = same-day underlying 1m K-line for entry/exit timing; success metric = option path/fills only (option PnL). Underlying-proxy payoff is forbidden.
$comment: The underlying 'symbol' supplies timing bars only and is never the traded/measured asset. 'contract' is the exact broker option code resolved and checked against underlying/right/expiry. Custody success must be measured on the option contract (custody/pnl.py); an underlying return x multiplier is not custody PnL.

strategy_id.description: Exact immutable registry ID; no automatic best/latest alias.

symbol.description: Human-selected underlying used ONLY for same-day 1m entry/exit timing signals. US. prefix accepted; uppercase normalized. Not the traded or measured asset.

direction.description: LONG buys CALL; SHORT buys PUT. Both are long the option and close by selling owned options; the product never writes/shorts an option.

contract.description: Exact broker option instrument code that is traded and measured. Resolved and checked against underlying/right/expiry; near-ATM and near expiry are expected.

trade_date.description: Optional; defaults to current America/New_York date. Active jobs must match today; use separate offline replay for history.
